prompts.intercom: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: photorealistic modeling reference sheet for a Korean apartment horror game, not a ready-made texture. Reference image: the attached actual KOCOM KCV-R431E product photo supplies the real compact proportions and construction. Create a visually consistent unbranded compact apartment video intercom: 140 mm wide, 203 mm tall, 26 mm deep; softly rounded ivory/champagne ABS housing, a very thin dark charcoal front panel, a SINGLE 4.3-inch landscape LCD inset into its upper third, four modest pale touch pictograms underneath (monitor, guard, handset, door), a tiny microphone aperture and narrow speaker slit. LCD is powered off, black glass with only a restrained natural room reflection. No logo, no letters, no digits, no second screen, no floating panel, no glow. Three orthographic views (front, right side, rear mounting plate) and one larger three-quarter view plus a small closeup of case seam/LCD recess, all depicting the same identical object at the same proportions. Clean warm gray background, evenly lit product photography, neutral white balance, realistic fine surface roughness, no exaggerated grime or dramatic lighting. Provide clear separation between views. Preserve the real object rather than inventing ornamental greebles. This will be rebuilt as actual 3D geometry, so accurately show thickness and wall mounting.
prompts.vest: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: photorealistic 3D modeling reference sheet for an ordinary work vest hanging inside a Korean studio apartment. Reference image: the attached Korean 3M manufacturer catalog, page 109; use the TOP RIGHT premium lime-yellow sleeveless reflective vest's practical construction as a reference, but remove all logos and copy. One ordinary lightly used fluorescent yellow-green polyester safety vest, black edge binding, open V neck, large armholes, a center black zip closed below the V, two silver-gray horizontal reflective tape bands around the torso and two over-shoulder vertical bands. Put it on a thin black triangular wire clothes hanger on a simple small wall hook; empty vest, no person or mannequin. Fabric hangs under gravity with restrained vertical folds and a slightly uneven hem; front and rear panels have actual separation/depth and empty armholes, not a stiff flat board. Reflection tape is matte gray in ambient light and DOES NOT emit light. Show one large straight front view, matching 3/4 left and 3/4 right views, a side view to explain how the empty garment hangs against a wall, and a macro of binding, stitched reflective tape and polyester weave. Identical garment in all views, no fanciful pockets, straps or tactical hardware, no text or logos. Neutral warm gray studio background, soft diffuse white product-photo lighting, quiet natural wear with no dirt decals or horror decoration. Adult vest approximately 52cm wide by 62cm tall, realistic folds and sewing.
